sourcePathConvention: player.* denotes one canonical per-Game participant statistics object; recordedEvents.* is a proposed join to already retained source-bearing command facts; official.* names existing official Match/Battle authority, NOT a single flattened player field. Bracket filters are specification selectors, NOT implemented JSONPath.

availabilityLegend.EXISTING_MEASUREMENT: Versioned metric/source already projected; award/record rule and current-source completeness/fairness STILL need review.
availabilityLegend.DERIVE: Underlying source facts or partial model exist; new pure compositional/checkpoint/identity detector is required.
availabilityLegend.ENGINE_WITNESS: Claimed completed/effective game-state effect is NOT defensible from current replay-command projection; withhold until independent engine-state or validated equivalent evidence.

projectionRules.oneVerifiedSource: Source-attributed qualified Game measurement once; THREE independent projections: Season/League records, owner private personal best, fixed achievement tier.
projectionRules.extrema: Apply record min/max only within approved compatible cohort; equal exact qualified values share all holders. Different models/contexts stay separate or unavailable.
projectionRules.dedupe: Canonical Game ID under authoritative Match/Battle; duplicate uploaded POV never counts twice; cumulative achievement counts distinct official matchId for Battle contribution.
projectionRules.correction: On source/result/identity/mapping/model revision or disputes, rebuild relevant current extrema, private PB, tier entitlements, honours, append-only correction journal; never persist stale public honour.
projectionRules.history: Former record holders distinguish historic once-valid achievement from CURRENT holder; invalid evidence revokes historical claim. PB survives being surpassed by others; weaker subsequent play never revokes earned validated tier.
projectionRules.unknown: PENDING_EVIDENCE is not zero, disqualification, or earned status.
projectionRules.scoring: No League Points, Reputation, Relationships, Gold, ladder rank, deployment or live award grants.
